children: Egyptian real estate developer Housing and Development Properties (HDP) has awarded the main construction contract worth EGP 4 billion ($71 million) for its Club Hills Residence project in the 6th of October City, the company said in a press statement.
The contract was awarded to CRC Dorra, the statement said.
A foundation stone ceremony on Monday marked the start of excavation, site grading and construction works at the 30-feddan (approximately 126,000 square metres) residential development in West Cairo.
Initial unit handovers are scheduled for 2028, with full project completion targeted for March 2029.
Located overlooking Al Jazira Sports Club, Club Hills Residence will comprise apartments and townhouses designed in collaboration with international architecture firm Benoy.
The statement did not disclose the total number of residential units or the project's overall investment value.
(Writing by Eman Hamed; Editing by Anoop Menon)
